uncertainty: Pointwise paired cluster percentile intervals conditional on frozen predictions; no retraining or biological-replicate uncertainty
direction: Positive effect means named baseline better; lower-is-better metrics are sign-reversed
single_aggregation: Mean contexts within target/split, mean splits within target, mean targets within dataset, macro equal datasets
double_aggregation: Mean contexts within pair/fold, mean pairs within fold, mean folds; nMSE20 ratio within each fold then mean folds
transfer_aggregation: Mean perturbations within context, macro equal four contexts; resample perturbation clusters jointly across contexts
missing: Secondary metrics paired complete-case within each comparison; denominators saved; direction DE with no observed DE is 0 to match current manuscript
p_values: Not reported; intervals are pointwise, not simultaneous
